name: react-native-shiki-engine-monorepo
description: Shiki syntax highlighting for React Native - Monorepo
author: Ryan Skinner <hello@ryanskinner.com> (https://github.com/skiniks)

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter react-native-shiki-engine build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter react-native-shiki-engine build && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm -r run lint && eslint packages/ examples/ scripts/ eslint.config.ts vite.config.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter react-native-shiki-engine build && pnpm fmt && pnpm -r run lint:fix && eslint packages/ examples/ scripts/ eslint.config.ts vite.config.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml --fix
scripts.lint:all: pnpm lint:fix && pnpm lint:cpp && pnpm lint:kt
